start: Admin app on a laptop browser, alerts off

steps.action: Turn on alerts when the app is closed
user_sees: The browser asks to allow notifications
must_not: A request with no key

steps.action: Allow
user_sees: Alerts on; this browser saved for alerts
must_not: The subscription saved for another gym

start: Admin app, the HQ link is not set up or HQ is down

steps.action: Turn on alerts
user_sees: A plain line that alerts cannot be switched on now
must_not: A success shown for alerts that will never come

steps.action: Turn alerts off, then on again
user_sees: The same key; alerts on again
must_not: Two subscriptions so each alert comes twice

start: Admin app asks for the key

steps.action: GET /api/push/web-key
user_sees: 200 with the public key from the HQ server
must_not: The private key ever returned
A key that is not 80-100 letters passed on

steps.action: POST to it
user_sees: 405 'GET_ONLY'
must_not: A key returned

steps.action: GET with the HQ_PUSH link missing
user_sees: 503 'NOT_SET_UP'
must_not: A crash or a made-up key

steps.action: GET while HQ does not answer
user_sees: 503 'UNREACHABLE'
must_not: A long hang

steps.action: Browsers ask again
user_sees: The new key within an hour (the answer is kept up to an hour)
must_not: The old key kept for longer than an hour
